summary.text: Michael Morgan is a Republican member of the Vermont House of Representatives for the Grand Isle-Chittenden District who has served since January 6, 2021, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner and notes his service in the U.S. Air Force and Vermont Air National Guard.

paragraphs.text: Morgan was born in Burlington, Vermont, and lives in Milton, Vermont.
He graduated from Milton High School in 1979 and earned a B.S. in biology from the United States Air Force Academy in 1983.
According to Ballotpedia, he served in the U.S. Air Force from 1983 to 2017 and in the Vermont Air National Guard from 1988 to 2017, and his career experience includes owning a business.

Morgan first took office in the Vermont House in January 2021, succeeding Mitzi Johnson (D), and Ballotpedia lists him on the Corrections and Institutions Committee in the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
He was re-elected in 2022 and again in 2024, when he and Leland Morgan (R) defeated incumbent Josie Leavitt (D) and Luke Richter (D) with 30.6 percent of the vote.
